title: Understanding the Table
text: The table shows the errors for different values of lambda (λ) across two folds. Your goal is to choose the λ that minimizes the error across all folds.

title: Comparing Errors for Each λ
text: For $$\lambda=1$$, the errors are $$1$$ and $$3$$. For $$\lambda=2$$, the errors are $$0.5$$ and $$1.5$$. For $$\lambda=3$$, the errors are $$9$$ and $$1$$. Which λ has the lowest total error?

title: Calculating Total Error for $$\lambda=1$$
text: Calculate the total error for $$\lambda=1$$ by adding the errors from both folds.

title: Calculating Total Error for $$\lambda=2$$
text: Calculate the total error for $$\lambda=2$$ by adding the errors from both folds.

title: Calculating Total Error for $$\lambda=3$$
text: Calculate the total error for $$\lambda=3$$ by adding the errors from both folds.

title: Choosing the Best λ
text: Compare the total errors for each λ. The λ with the smallest total error is the best choice.
